# Schema Merge

## Rules

- Export synchronous pure mergeSchemaLayers(base: SchemaYamlData, layers: readonly SchemaLayer[]): SchemaYamlData in domain/services/merge-schema-layers.ts.
- SchemaLayer source extends|plugin|override, human ref, optional operations remove/create/prepend/append/set.
- Per-layer order remove → create → prepend → append → set. Layer order root-to-parent extends, declared plugins, one project override.
- Identity: artifacts id; workflow step; hooks/validations/deltaValidations/rules/preHashCleanup id; metadataExtraction rules/constraints/scenarios/context id. Nested operation identifies parent then child.
- remove deletes existing identity; null removes optional scalar; missing/required target throws SchemaValidationError. create/prepend/append reject collisions and preserve declared order. set scalars last-writer-wins, replaces existing array entry in-place.
- Targets mirror top scalars, artifacts/workflow and nested fields. Post-merge validate unique IDs and artifact.requires references; errors identify layer/operation. Return new data, never mutate inputs.

## Constraints

- No I/O/fs/yaml/zod; synchronous domain service only.
- No application/infrastructure/composition imports.
- Operates intermediate SchemaYamlData below entities/buildSchema.
